newsitem.title: GERMANY: German TV group names new banks for share issue.
newsitem.headline: German TV group names new banks for share issue.

text.p: Germany's ProSieben Media AG said on Monday that three additional banks had signed on as underwriters for its share listing, the first of a German television network, that is scheduled for July.
The network said in a statement that the new underwriters were Deutsche Morgan Grenfell (DMG), the investment arm of Deutsche Bank AG, Bankgesellschaft Berlin and Bayerische Vereinsbank.

ProSieben, whose main shareholders are the Rewe retail group and Thomas Kirch, son of Bavarian media mogul Leo Kirch, plans to float 17.5 million non-voting preference shares on stock exchanges in July.

The lead underwriting banks are BHF Bank, Hypo-Bank and Salomon Brothers. Co-lead managers are Commerzbank , DMG, DG Bank and Goldman Sachs. Co-managers are Bankgesellschaft Berlin, Bayerische Vereinsbank and CS First Boston.
